zh: 文明航程
en: Civilization Voyage
zh_body:
乘一条船，
走进技术改变生活的时刻。
en_body:
A voyage through lives
changed by technology.
note_zh: A｜开场。文明航程是一款以中华文明与世界文化为内容的3D航海游戏。玩家从一座神殿出发，选择一个时代，再驶入中国或世界的航线。我们希望把历史带回人的生活：河道修通以后，谁能用上水；机器转快以后，谁得到了休息；消息传得更远以后，谁仍没有被听见。游戏让玩家在故事中作决定，再带着结果走向下一站。下面先介绍这段航程怎样开始。
note_en: A | Civilization Voyage is a 3D sailing game built around Chinese civilization and world cultures. A player leaves a hall, chooses an era and follows a China or world route. We bring history into the scale of everyday life: who receives the water after a channel opens, who gains rest when a machine runs faster, and who remains unheard when messages travel farther? Players make arrangements within those stories and carry their consequences to the next scene. Begin with the experience of departing rather than a list of features.

zh: 一款可以亲身参与的文明故事游戏
en: A game about living through civilization
zh_body: 驾驶一条船，穿过农业、工业、信息与人工智能四个时代。
在中国与世界的历史处境里，遇见人物、完成任务、承担选择的后果。
技术改变我们能做什么；文明关乎我们如何一起生活。
en_body: Sail through agriculture, industry, information and artificial intelligence.
Meet people in Chinese and world histories, act and live with the consequences.
Technology changes what we can do. Civilization concerns how we live together.
note_zh: A｜文明航程的完整定位是文化叙事航海游戏。航海提供探索感，人物提供处境，选择与后果让技术史进入人的生活。整个App围绕同一个问题组织：能力增长之后，人们怎样分配成果、承担责任和维持共同生活？这是跨时代的观察角度，不把复杂历史归结为单一规律，也不把文明排成高低顺序。
note_en: A | Position the whole app as a cultural narrative sailing game. Exploration provides movement, characters provide situations and consequences bring technological history into everyday life. The recurring question is how people distribute gains, share responsibility and sustain life together as their capabilities change. This is a lens for comparison, not a single law of history or a ranking of civilizations.

zh: 内海看中国，外海看世界
en: China in the inner sea; the world beyond
zh_body: 农业、工业、信息、人工智能：四个时代，八条航线。
每条线依年代展开；切换时代，就是进入新的历史篇章。
在不同的处境中，看人怎样安排水、粮食、劳动、消息与判断。
en_body: Four eras and eight routes: agriculture, industry, information and AI.
Each route moves forward in time; changing eras opens another historical chapter.
Different settings reveal how people arrange water, food, work, messages and judgment.
note_zh: A｜说明比较的范围。内海对应中国，外海对应世界。四个时代各有两条航线，共24个故事场景。我们比较的是具体情境里的安排，避免把文明排成高低顺序。时代之间有历史重叠，玩家也不是以一人的寿命亲历几千年；切换时代是进入新的篇章。小组原有“玄览玄通”的部分在这里落实为理解处境、阅读材料和形成问题，术语的正式含义仍以课程讲义为准。接下来用全景图介绍四时代的八条航线。
note_en: A | Explain the comparison without ranking civilizations. There are two routes in each era and twenty-four scenes in total. Routes have their own chronology; the eras can overlap, and the player is not literally a single historical person living across millennia. The first team responsibility, Xuanlan Xuantong, is expressed here through understanding a setting, reading its evidence and forming a question. Formal philosophical definitions should follow the course materials. Next, show the full eight-route map.

zh: 四个时代，八条可以进入的故事线
en: Four eras. Eight routes into history.
note_zh: A｜按行看时代，按列看中国和世界。农业讨论资源与协作；工业讨论知识、生产与劳动；信息讨论连接与参与；人工智能讨论判断与责任。每条航线内部按时间前进，传说和未来推演明确标注。矩阵只是选取代表场景，不是每个时代的完整历史。24个故事场景共同构成当前产品，而非只有一条农业航线。
note_en: A | Read eras by row and China and world routes by column. Agriculture concerns resources and cooperation; industry concerns knowledge, production and work; information concerns connection and participation; AI concerns judgment and responsibility. Routes move forward in time. Legends and imagined futures are labelled. The matrix summarizes representative scenes rather than claiming an exhaustive history. All twenty-four scenes belong to the present product.
zh_cells: 粮仓 → 记录 → 分配
林则徐 → 魏源 → 京张铁路
瓦特 → 工厂劳动与工时
上海海缆 → 津沪电报 → 办学
电报 → 跨洋电缆 → 信息论
调度 → 隐私 → 未来港口

zh: 两片海，让相似的问题照见不同的回答
en: Two seas, different answers to shared questions
zh_body: 中国线从自身的历史经验出发：治水、求知、兴学、共同生活。
世界线打开比较的视野：城市记账、工厂劳动、跨洋通信、机器判断。
玩家带回的，是理解不同处境的能力，以及对自己选择的解释。
en_body: China’s routes begin with local experiences of water, learning and shared life.
World routes widen the view through records, factory work, communication and machine judgment.
Players return with a way to understand different situations and explain their own choices.
note_zh: B｜中华文明是理解自身经验的起点，世界文化提供相互参照。比较具体处境、人物和制度，不用一个抽象价值裁判所有文明。技术效率不能独自解释共同生活的好坏。希望形成的文化理解需要用户研究验证，不能把设计意图说成已经证明的教学效果。 配图分别为瓦特肖像与1866年大东方号，说明工业与信息时代的背景，并非游戏实时截图。
note_en: B | Chinese civilization grounds the experience, while world cultures provide reciprocal perspectives. Compare concrete situations and arrangements without treating one society as a universal standard. Technical efficiency alone does not explain the quality of shared life. Cultural understanding is an intended outcome that still needs evaluation. Images show a contextual portrait of Watt and the Great Eastern in 1866, representing industrial and information-era material rather than live game screenshots.

zh: 船上带着补给，也带着人的信任
en: The ship carries provisions and people’s trust
zh_body: 补给用来维持航行，也用来整修船体。
人心关系到合作支援，也让船员换上新的行装。
为今天省下的粮食，可能在下一站付出别的代价。
en_body: Supplies sustain the voyage and pay for ship refits.
Trust affects cooperation and opens new crew outfits.
Saving provisions today can change the terms of the next encounter.
note_zh: B｜这里讲清游戏的核心资源。补给是船上的粮与水，也是改造船体所需的物资；人心用一个简化数值表现合作关系，不能代表完整的人性或文明高低。合作可能付出眼前补给，却在下一站得到工料帮助。人心过低，支援会暂停。船坞能预览和购买实际船体改造；人心达到门槛后解锁行装，不作为货币扣除。变化会出现在海上的船和原船员身上，也写入存档。
note_en: B | Explain the two game resources in ordinary terms. Supplies are food and water and the materials for refits. Trust is a simplified representation of cooperation, not a measure of civilization or of a person’s worth. An agreement can use provisions now and bring support later; low trust suspends that support. The shipyard previews and purchases refits that appear on the sailing ship. Trust thresholds unlock outfits without spending trust as a currency. The original crew remains recognizable, and progress is saved.

zh: 对话之后，轮到你掌舵
en: After the conversation, take the helm
zh_body: 开进浮标门，作出选择。
稳住光环，或收集水面物件。
完成操作后，决定怎样安排成果。
en_body: Steer through a buoy gate to make a choice.
Hold inside a ring or collect objects on the water.
After the task, decide how to use its result.
note_zh: B｜README的操作很直接：WASD航行，靠近人物按E，空格或“下一句”推进对白，Escape返回，B打开船坞。任务包含浮标门、光环停船、收集和顺序校验。操作奖励和社会选择分开结算，因此操作做得好，仍然要想清楚成果怎样分配。屏幕上的指引应使玩家知道眼前该做什么，再通过故事理解为什么这样做。我们已经针对各类入口、退出和结算作了验证，但不把局部验证说成全部路线的连续人工通关。
note_en: B | The README gives a simple set of controls: WASD to sail, E near a character, Space or Next Line to advance speech, Escape to return and B for the shipyard. Tasks include buoy gates, holding position, collection and sequence checking. Task rewards and social choices settle separately. A successful action still leaves a decision about its use. We have checked native access, exits and settlement branches; that should not be described as a continuous manual completion of every route.

zh: 回港时，重新看一遍自己的选择
en: Return to shore and look back at the choices
zh_body: 上一站留下的合作，会改变下一站得到的帮助。
船可能因缺粮停下，也可能因为无人愿意同行而停下。
回港的人，应该说起你真正走过的这一程。
en_body: Earlier cooperation changes the help available later.
A voyage can stop for lack of provisions or of willing companions.
The closing voice should recall the journey you actually made.
note_zh: B｜一条航线依次经过两座岛和一场共同危机，最后回港总结。总结人物适配这段历史，回顾读取玩家的实际选择。资源归零后，游戏会停航；玩家可以承担扣分、耐久和相应外观降级的代价重整，也可以把坏结局记入日志。故事选择不会因此清空。这使反思有具体的事情可回看。我们把知行合一落实为理解、行动、遭遇后果、重新理解的学习经历；哲学术语仍以课程材料的正式解释为准。
note_en: B | A route links two islands, a shared crisis and a return to shore. Its closing figure belongs to the period and recalls recorded choices. When a resource reaches zero, sailing stops. Players can pay the stated recovery costs or preserve a bad ending in the log; earlier story choices remain. Reflection therefore has something concrete to revisit. We connect the team’s knowledge-and-action theme to understanding, acting, meeting consequences and reconsidering an explanation. Formal philosophical definitions remain those of the course materials.

zh: 看一段实际航程
en: Watch a passage through the actual game
note_zh: C｜播放约2分43秒的Demo。镜头来自实际游戏，使用演示专用的预置存档和真实键鼠操作，后期加入游戏原声、合成旁白、字幕与章节。内容包括岛上互动、升级、补给耗尽后的重整、人心归零后的结局和回港。演示经过剪辑，并不是从头连续通关全部路线。中文理解版配中文旁白与字幕，游戏画面使用同一份实录。播放后用一两句引导观众想起：哪一个决定影响了后来的同行者？
note_en: C | Play the approximately 2:43 film. It records actual gameplay with prepared demonstration saves and real keyboard and mouse actions, edited with game audio, synthetic narration, captions and chapters. It includes encounters, upgrades, resource failure, recovery and a return to shore. It is edited rather than an uninterrupted completion of all routes. The Chinese understanding edition uses Chinese narration and subtitles over the same gameplay. Afterwards, invite the audience to recall a choice that affected later cooperation.

zh: 听人物说话，也能停下来读资料
en: Hear the character; pause to read the context.
zh_body: 人物与字幕留在原来的场景里。
配乐随时代变化，动作和音效一起发生。
想多了解一点时，再打开岛上的图片背景。
en_body: Characters and subtitles stay within their scenes.
Music changes with the era; actions have synchronized effects.
Open the island’s image notes when you want more context.
note_zh: C｜项目保留原有的人物、场景和浮动字幕，也为四时代安排原创合成配乐。接到物件、进入光环和完成操作会触发对应音效。24个故事场景都有可选的图片背景与来源说明，区分后世画像、现代照片和历史图像。阅读背景不推进章节，也不给资源奖励。中英文和大字可随时切换，当前对白、资源和航程进度继续保留。讲这些细节，是为了说明玩家怎样在一个场景里听人说话、观察、行动与停下来阅读。
note_en: C | The project preserves its original characters, scenery and floating subtitles and provides original synthesized music for the four eras. Collection, entering a ring and task completion trigger related sound cues. Optional image notes accompany all twenty-four scenes and identify later portraits, modern photographs and historical images. Reading them neither completes a chapter nor awards resources. Language and text-size controls preserve current dialogue and progress. These details support listening, observing, acting and pausing to read within one world.

zh: 现在，这片海已经可以航行
en: The voyage is already playable
zh_body: 3D场景、人物、字幕与水上任务已连在一起。
四时代配乐、图片背景、船坞与结局已经进入同一主线。
当前已有可玩的产品；学习效果、留存与付费需求，需要真实使用验证。
en_body: 3D scenes, characters, subtitles and water tasks form one route.
Music, image notes, refits and endings are part of the same game.
A playable product exists; learning, retention and demand still need real-world evidence.
note_zh: C｜现有版本有4时代、8航线、24个故事场景。3D航行、人物对白、资源选择、升级、背景阅读、双语、存档和结局已实现。实录展示其中的操作与后果，不代表所有内容连续通关。课程效果、用户留存与商业收入尚未得到验证。高级RAG、机构后台与内容交易没有作为已完成能力展示。
note_en: C | The current build has four eras, eight routes and twenty-four scenes. Sailing, dialogue, choices, refits, contextual reading, bilingual display, saves and endings are implemented. The film demonstrates selected mechanics, not uninterrupted completion of everything. Learning outcomes, retention and revenue remain unvalidated. Advanced retrieval, institutional management and a content marketplace are not presented as delivered.

zh: 这片海是怎样做出来的
en: How this world was put together
zh_body: 先确定场景与视觉，再约定接口。
把3D、故事、存档和规则逐层接起来。
在浏览器里验证，再更新桌面App。
en_body: Begin with scenes and visual direction, then agree on interfaces.
Connect the 3D world, stories, saves and rules.
Check the behaviour in a browser, then update the desktop app.
note_zh: C｜如实介绍开发过程。GitHub记录了初始框架、设计规范、接口与React/Three.js前端的交接；文档将设计交给Claude、接口交给Codex、前端与3D交给Grok。这是交接记录，不是每次模型调用的独立审计。项目在本机用FastAPI与SQLite承载数据，用Vite、React与Three.js呈现场景，再补齐保存、浏览器验证和桌面包装。Lovable可帮助解释“自然语言构建、代码同步GitHub、继续本地开发”的工作方式，但没有证据说这个仓库由Lovable导出。文化材料选择、历史次序与用户体验仍需要人反复核对。
note_en: C | Describe the documented workflow honestly. GitHub records the framework, design, API contracts and React/Three.js handoffs. The documents assign design to Claude, APIs to Codex and the frontend/3D work to Grok; they are not an audit of every model call. FastAPI and SQLite support data locally, while Vite, React and Three.js render the game. Saves, browser checks and the desktop wrapper made revisions usable. Lovable is a useful parallel for natural-language building, GitHub synchronization and continued local work; a Lovable origin is not established for this repository.

zh: 当机器也会回答，决定交给谁
en: When machines can answer, who decides?
zh_body: 在港口，调度表可以更快；乘员仍应知道交出了什么信息。
在棋盘上，一手好棋证明了本领；换一件事，还需要新的依据。
AI辅助制作；历史判断、内容选择与最终责任，仍由人承担。
en_body: A port can schedule faster while passengers still need to know what data they give.
A strong move shows an ability on the board; another task needs other evidence.
AI assists production; people remain responsible for historical judgment, content and final decisions.
note_zh: C｜人工智能时代的两条线把责任留在故事里：中国线从2017年的港口调度背景，到2021年的个人信息保护背景，再进入标明的2035年未来推演；世界线从图灵与ELIZA的问题走向2016年AlphaGo棋局，由李世石回顾。项目用这些处境讨论效率、隐私与判断的边界。AI可以辅助制作，但选材、历史核对、表达和最终责任需要由人承担。当前文化主线的故事与规则经过编写，不依赖付费模型调用。
note_en: C | The AI routes keep responsibility within a story. China moves from a 2017 scheduling setting through a 2021 personal-information setting into an explicitly imagined 2035 port. The world route moves from Turing and ELIZA towards the 2016 AlphaGo match, with Lee Sedol closing. These situations raise questions about efficiency, privacy and the limits of judgment. AI can assist production, while people remain responsible for selection, historical review, expression and final decisions. The current authored voyage does not require paid model calls.

zh: 同一段文化体验，可以走进不同的生活
en: One cultural experience, several places in life
zh_body: 个人玩家：为好故事、探索与有分量的选择投入时间。
教育机构：需要可信内容、可组织的体验，以及讨论与回顾材料。
文博机构：希望把藏品与地方记忆转化为可以参与、可以延续的故事。
en_body: Players give their time to compelling stories, exploration and meaningful choices.
Educators need credible content, manageable sessions and material for reflection.
Museums can connect collections and local memory to participatory stories.
note_zh: D｜个人玩家为完整游戏和新故事付费；教育机构为可组织的内容与服务付费；文博伙伴为有权使用的文化内容制作与持续传播付费。页面使用现有游戏画面说明共同内容基础，并不是已经上线的机构版或真实客户照片。三种商业包装均待验证。先验证玩家参与，再逐步扩大机构使用。
note_en: D | Players pay for the game and new stories; educators pay for usable content and services; museums pay for rights-cleared production and interpretation. The image is from the current game, not a delivered institutional edition or a customer deployment. All three commercial packages remain proposals. Establish engagement before widening distribution.

zh: 把未来十二个月，放进三种情景
en: Three scenarios for the next twelve months
zh_body: 起点：对历史与技术议题有兴趣、愿意主动体验的玩家，以及能参与试用的教师。
扩展：经过验证的文化主题与双语内容，进入更多课程、社群和文化空间。
规模：分别用付费玩家、付费机构和合作合同测算，依据真实转化逐步更新。
en_body: Start with reachable history-minded players and educators willing to test the experience.
Expand proven themes and bilingual content into more communities, courses and cultural spaces.
Size each opportunity through paying players, paying institutions and contracts, using observed conversion.
note_zh: D｜情景测算，不是市场统计或销售预测。统一假设游戏68元、机构年度服务12000元、文博合同60000元。谨慎为500名付费玩家、3家机构、0个合同，收入7万元；基准为2000、10、2，收入37.6万元；扩展为5000、25、4，收入88万元。单价与销量均需验证。年度合同按完整服务周期口径，无续约、无故事包收入，避免重复计算。基准获客逻辑可由10万次合格访问、10%体验、20%购买，以及100个机构账户10%成交和20个文博接洽10%成交推导；这些是待测试的转化假设。收入不是利润，成本见第20页。
note_en: D | These are scenarios, not market statistics or forecasts. Assumed prices are CNY68 per game, 12000 per annual education service and 60000 per museum contract. Cautious volumes of 500 players, 3 institutions and no contracts yield CNY70000. Base volumes of 2000, 10 and 2 yield 376000; expansion volumes of 5000, 25 and 4 yield 880000. Annual services cover full delivery periods. No renewals or expansion sales are added. A base acquisition hypothesis is 100000 qualified visits, 10% trying and 20% buying, plus 100 institution accounts at 10% and 20 museum conversations at 10%. Every input requires testing. Revenue is not profit; see page20.
section_zh: BP · 数字均为规划假设

zh: 对标竞品，明确我们的差异化定位
en: Competitive benchmarks and our position
zh_body: 以历史世界的探索与讲解见长，并提供教师使用材料。
以广泛的学习活动与机构许可，支持学校组织使用。
围绕四时代与中外比较，把人物、行动后果和航程回顾连在一起。
en_body: Historical exploration and interpretation, supported by teaching materials.
Broad learning activities with institutional licensing for school use.
Four eras and China/world comparison, connecting characters, consequences and reflection.
note_zh: D｜截至2026年11月5日查询，Ubisoft美国商店Discovery Tour Ancient Greece标价19.99美元；Minecraft Education官网合格教育机构直接购买为5.04美元每用户每年，商业组织为36美元每用户每年，年度承诺。页面保留美元和计费单位，不混用汇率，也不说两者可以直接比较。这些参照说明买断与年度许可都存在，不证明本项目68元或机构年费可行。本项目教育方案包含拟议服务，不等同于席位软件许可。来源：https://store.ubisoft.com/us/assassins-creed-discovery-tour?lang=default ；https://education.minecraft.net/en-us/licensing 。 本页结论：我们希望把中外文化探索与选择后果结合起来，为个人游玩、课堂讨论和文博叙事提供共同内容基础。这是待验证的差异化定位，不是已证明的竞品优势。下一页把定位转成三种商品与服务。
note_en: D | Checked 2026-11-05: Ubisoft US lists Discovery Tour Ancient Greece at USD19.99. Minecraft Education lists USD5.04 per user/year for eligible educational organizations and USD36 per user/year for commercial organizations, with annual commitment. Keep currencies and billing units visible. These illustrate purchase and annual-license models, not directly comparable products or evidence of willingness to pay for our proposal. Our proposed institutional package includes services rather than a comparable seat licence. Sources: https://store.ubisoft.com/us/assassins-creed-discovery-tour?lang=default ; https://education.minecraft.net/en-us/licensing . Our proposed position combines Chinese and world cultural exploration with decisions and consequences, providing a common foundation for play, teaching and museum storytelling. This is a differentiation hypothesis, not a proven advantage. The next slide translates that position into three proposed offers.

zh: 先给出可测试的价格与交付边界
en: Prices to test, with clear delivery boundaries
zh_body: 个人版：完整游戏与新增故事包，为持续的游玩体验付费。
教育版：年度内容与教学服务，为组织使用、更新与支持付费。
文博合作：内容制作与使用许可，明确授权范围与维护费用。
en_body: Player edition: a complete game and story expansions, purchased for the experience.
Education edition: annual content and teaching services, with updates and support.
Museum partnerships: production and usage agreements with defined rights and maintenance.
note_zh: D｜全部为建议测试价格，人民币。个人完整游戏68元，未来新增故事包28元；模型只算基础游戏。教育服务12000元每机构每年，拟含现有内容、使用指南、2次远程培训和限定支持；不含新课程定制。文博基础合作60000元每项目，假设1个主题3个场景、2轮审读及约定期维护，不含现场硬件、复杂集成与第三方高价授权。实际范围和报价需访谈与成本核验。左图为当前农业线实录；中图以工业线瓦特资料制作课堂讨论页示意；右图以信息线跨洋电缆资料制作展陈示意。教育与文博交付尚属规划。MIT代码不能作为排他版权收费。
note_en: D | All are proposed test prices in CNY. Full game68; future expansion28, excluded from the model. Education service12000 per institution/year: existing content, guides, two remote training sessions and bounded support, excluding custom curricula. Museum starting scope60000 per project: one theme with three scenes, two review rounds and contracted maintenance, excluding hardware, complex integration and expensive third-party rights. Validate scope and costs before quoting. The left image is actual agriculture-route gameplay. The centre is a proposed discussion guide using the industrial route’s Watt material. The right is a proposed museum exhibit using the information route’s cable material. These service concepts are not delivered editions. MIT code is not exclusive intellectual property.
section_zh: BP · 数字均为规划假设

zh: 增长假设，要落实到每一步转化
en: Make the acquisition hypothesis measurable
zh_body: 以现有游戏触达历史与独立游戏社群，观察首次体验和主动回访。
与愿意共同改进的教师试用，形成可重复使用的课程材料与案例。
把经过验证的内容带给文博伙伴，通过联合传播扩大触达。
en_body: Reach history and indie-game communities; observe first sessions and voluntary return.
Work with willing educators to develop reusable materials and documented cases.
Bring proven content to museum partners and extend reach through joint distribution.
note_zh: D｜基准个人端假设：10万次合格访问，10%进入体验为1万次体验，20%体验者购买为2000名付费玩家。不是现实流量或实际转化。按每名付费玩家18元获客成本，预算36000元，相当于每次合格访问0.36元的现金成本；合格访问须去重，创作者和团队工作时间仍计入固定成本。目标漏斗不代表可以用这个成本买到流量。机构另算100个合格账户取得10个年度合同；文博20个接洽取得2个合同。高低情景同比调整获客投入，并检验成本随规模上升的可能。
note_en: D | Base consumer hypothesis:100000 qualified visits,10% trying gives10000 trials,20% of trials buying gives2000 paying players. None is observed traction. At CNY18 acquisition per buyer, cash spend is36000, or0.36 per qualified visit. Deduplicate visits; team effort remains in fixed costs. This does not establish that traffic is purchasable at that cost. Separately assume100 qualified institutions produce10 contracts and20 museum conversations produce2. Scale acquisition costs with volumes and test whether they worsen with reach.
section_zh: BP · 数字均为规划假设

zh: 每完成一段历史，留下可以继续使用的积累
en: Each release should strengthen the next
zh_body: 资料与权利：可追溯的来源、审读记录、图片许可与版本。
叙事与制作：人物、任务、后果和双语表达形成可复用的制作规范。
品牌与关系：稳定的内容质量、用户信任和持续合作的机构。
en_body: Evidence and rights: traceable sources, review records, image licences and versions.
Production: reusable practices for characters, tasks, consequences and bilingual writing.
Trust and relationships: reliable releases, returning users and repeat partners.
note_zh: E｜来源链接本身是基础，不是壁垒。长期优势来自持续审读、故事质量、资产权利清晰、制作效率和渠道关系的共同积累。当前具备故事数据结构与图片来源，但没有成熟编辑平台、独家史料或已验证的用户网络。AI可以辅助代码、翻译草稿和素材整理，人负责选材、历史判断与最终表达。RAG未来可辅助查证，须有来源与拒答机制，不能假装已经实现。
note_en: E | Source links alone are basic hygiene rather than a moat. Defensibility could emerge from consistent editorial quality, clear asset rights, production efficiency and distribution relationships. Story data and image sources exist; a mature authoring platform, exclusive archives and proven network effects do not. AI can assist code, draft translation and organization; people own selection and historical judgment. Future retrieval must cite sources and handle uncertainty.

zh: 收入增长，还要跨过成本这一关
en: Revenue must still clear the cost base
zh_body: 游戏：净收入减去渠道、退款与服务成本；用贡献覆盖内容制作和获客。
教育：合同收入减去实施、支持与内容更新；重点看续约和服务工时。
文博：项目收入减去制作、权利与维护；重点看回款和通用内容的复用。
en_body: Game: net receipts less distribution, refunds and service costs; contribution funds content and acquisition.
Education: contract revenue less onboarding, support and updates; track renewal and service hours.
Museums: revenue less production, rights and maintenance; track cash collection and reusable work.
note_zh: E｜全部为12个月同口径假设。游戏68元减渠道和退款合计13.6元、服务4元、获客18元，单位贡献32.4元；机构12000减交付4000减销售2000，贡献6000；文博60000减制作权利交付36000减销售6000，贡献18000。基准贡献=2000×32.4+10×6000+2×18000=160800元。扣除独立固定投入240000元，税前经营测算余额为-79200元。谨慎-205800，扩展+144000。固定投入包括产品开发120000、通用内容90000、固定运营30000，均按本期现金费用处理，交付中的人力不得再重复计入固定成本。若机构10家、文博2项保持不变，约4445名付费玩家可覆盖固定投入；需重新检验支持能力。获客每人增加10元会令基准余额再减少20000元。该简化测算未计税与融资，不等同于审计利润或现金流。
note_en: E | All are twelve-month assumptions. A game nets68-13.6 channel/refunds-4 service-18 acquisition=32.4 contribution. An institution nets12000-4000 delivery-2000 sales=6000. A museum project nets60000-36000 delivery/rights-6000 sales=18000. Base contribution is160800. Less240000 separate fixed investment gives a pre-tax model balance of-79200. Cautious balance is-205800 and expansion+144000. Fixed investment comprises engineering120000, reusable content90000 and operations30000, expensed in this model; avoid counting delivery labour twice. With10 institutions and2 museum contracts, about4445 paying players cover fixed costs, subject to capacity. A CNY10 CAC increase reduces the base result by20000. This simplified model excludes tax and financing and is not audited profit or cash flow.
section_zh: BP · 数字均为规划假设

zh: 从一款游戏，长成持续更新的文化作品
en: From a game to an enduring cultural catalogue
zh_body: 现在：打磨现有八条航线，验证玩家是否愿意玩完并再来。
下一阶段：形成故事包与教育使用方案，验证付费、复用和交付成本。
长期：与文化机构合作扩展内容，建立稳定的编辑、发行与授权能力。
en_body: Now: refine all eight routes and test completion and voluntary return.
Next: test expansions and educational use against payment, reuse and delivery cost.
Long term: expand with cultural partners and build dependable editorial, publishing and licensing capabilities.
note_zh: E｜这是有条件的路线图。第一阶段看脱离现场讲解能否理解并完成，是否自发回来；第二阶段看真实支付、毛利和第二次使用；第三阶段看伙伴续约、内容复用和现金流。条件不成立就调整产品与范围，而不是按日历自动扩张。内容供给和编辑质量稳定之后，才评估创作者工具与更开放的内容生态，当前不提前宣称平台网络效应。
note_en: E | This is a gated roadmap. First establish independent comprehension, completion and voluntary return. Then measure real payment, contribution and reuse. Expand partnerships only with repeat contracts, reusable content and sustainable cash flow. If evidence fails, change scope rather than expanding on a calendar. Consider creator tools only after content quality and production are reliable; platform network effects are not a current asset.

zh: 36万元，支持一年的验证与制作
en: CNY360k for a year of production and validation
zh_body: 产品与内容：补齐可读性、可玩性、史料审读和内容权利。
市场验证：小规模测试玩家付费与机构采购，记录获客和交付成本。
经营能力：明确更新节奏、现金支出与团队分工，再决定扩张规模。
en_body: Product and content: improve readability, play, historical review and asset rights.
Market evidence: test player purchases and institutional procurement with measured costs.
Operations: establish release cadence, cash needs and responsibilities before expanding.
note_zh: E｜这是12个月资金规划示例，不是已获投资或正式融资要约。产品开发12万元、通用内容审读9万元、固定运营3万元，固定投入合计24万元。交付周转9万元、风险储备3万元，资金上限合计36万元。周转金是等待回款时使用的现金缓冲，不在第20页再扣为一笔费用；储备也不是已花费成本。团队薪酬与外部服务均需包含在对应成本，不假定五名全职员工可以靠此预算运行。建议先释放12万元，剩余24万元依据真实完成率、付费和交付工时再分阶段释放。工资报价与回款计划不充分，故这是可调整的规划规模，不承诺精确现金续航期。
note_en: E | This is an illustrative twelve-month cash envelope, not raised funding or a formal offering. Engineering120k, reusable content/review90k and core operations30k total240k fixed investment. Delivery float90k and contingency30k bring the envelope to360k. Float bridges cash timing and is not another expense in page20; contingency is not spent cost. Include labour and external fees in the appropriate lines; this does not fund five full-time salaries by assumption. Release120k first, then stage the remaining240k against completion, payment and delivery effort. Staffing quotes and collection schedules are incomplete, so exact runway is not promised.
section_zh: BP · 数字均为规划假设

zh: 决定能走多远的，是这些难题
en: What could limit the voyage?
zh_body: 内容有意义，但不好玩：用独立试玩和回访检验，持续调整节奏与操作。
有机构兴趣，却没有预算：找准采购人，核实预算、决策周期与续用理由。
订单越来越多，团队越做越累：控制定制比例，复用通用内容，计算支持成本。
en_body: Meaningful but not enjoyable: use independent sessions and return behaviour to improve play.
Interest without a budget: identify the purchaser, decision cycle and reason to renew.
More projects but less capacity: limit bespoke work, reuse content and measure support costs.
note_zh: E｜这些风险直接影响长期商业质量。文化误读和版权问题需要审读与权利清单；采购慢需要现金规划；内容更新慢需要缩小制作单元。用户行为分析须告知且最小化采集，不能把个人数据出售当成收入来源。商业路径可以扩大，真实故事、清楚的权利和稳定体验是扩张的前提。
note_en: E | These risks shape the quality of the business. Historical misrepresentation and rights require review; slow procurement requires cash planning; slow releases require smaller production units. Any analytics must be disclosed and minimized; selling personal information is not a proposed revenue line. Broader distribution depends on credible content, clear rights and reliable play.

zh: 让历史成为一种可以参与的文化生活
en: Make history a culture people can take part in
zh_body: 从中华文明出发，在世界文化中相互理解。
让技术的每一次进步，都回到人的处境与选择。
以值得反复游玩的作品，支撑持续的创作与经营。
en_body: Begin with Chinese civilization and encounter the world with curiosity.
Bring technological change back to human situations and choices.
Build work worth returning to, and a business that can keep creating it.
note_zh: E｜文明航程的远景是持续创作的文化游戏品牌。现有App是第一部可以玩的作品：四时代、八航线、24个场景。它的文化意义体现在人物、处境和选择；它的商业前景取决于内容能否吸引人、被反复使用并覆盖持续创作的成本。下一步寻找真实玩家、愿意共创的教师与文化伙伴，用使用和交易的证据决定发展。
note_en: E | The ambition is an enduring cultural game brand. The existing app is its first playable work: four eras, eight routes and twenty-four scenes. Cultural meaning lives in the people, situations and choices; commercial potential depends on engagement, repeat use and funding continued creation. Seek real players, educators and cultural partners, and let evidence guide expansion.
